email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGlutide patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 23-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their fourth dose of their usual medication (dose: 2 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-03-22.
Approximately 5 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Silva (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter663@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
